steps.text: 'Hello, Mary. When was the last time I wrote to you? I'm afraid I was never able to muster the courage to speak to you after the incident.
I could not sleep at all last night. Memories from childhood kept intruding into my mind.
Remember when you were fifteen, and we climbed up the judge statue in the center of town?
You joked that it was illegal, and that you would arrest me when you became a cop.
And I... what did I say?
'Everyone has the right to enjoy fairness and justice.'
I could not have imagined what would become of me in just a few years.
Civilization is a fragile thing. Not much separates us from the burdenbeasts outside the nomadic cities.
Fairness and justice have become alien concepts. All I think of, day in, day out, is how to survive.
Yes, I have become the kind of man you most despise. The kind that I used to most despise.
(Signs of erasure)
What if I have the chance to return to the embrace of civilization? To go back to the man I used to be?
Your birthday is just a week away. You have no idea how much I would love to surprise you.
(Long blank, then hastily scribbled words)
They're performing dangerous experiments on us. All I can do is try to keep living.'

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: S-Sir. Our bolts...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: They... stopped in mid-air?
The bolts headed towards her and the lab equipment are frozen in mid-air.
It is as though they are being held by countless invisible hands.
Dorothy raises a hand.
She touches one of the bolts with her finger.
It gives off a light hum.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hit the deck!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: What the...?
There is a loud bang, like a heavy metal object being dropped to the floor.
The bolts have fallen to the ground—but only part of them. The heads of the bolts have disappeared, leaving behind only an eerily smooth cross-section.
No, they did not disappear.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did you hear that, Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It sounded like...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Like metal vibrating at an extremely high frequency.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The heads of the bolts shook themselves apart.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How powerful could Director Franks's Originium Arts be?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's not all Arts.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's her technique. She's THE authority on applied Originium Arts.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The Pioneers won't be able to lay a finger on her.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're right. There's someone else we should be worried about...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Oww...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Take care of Joyce. She's still in bad shape.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Not to mention Sonny and his men...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Firebomb!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't aim, just throw!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Good god...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why... why won't you listen?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I don't want to see you hurt.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Why don't you tell that to the men you tricked onto your lab table?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I didn't trick them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They're safe. Very safe.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If the experiment succeeds, they'll never have to face the dangers of the wastes again.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Isn't that what you wanted, Sonny?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam...?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Sir... Sonny, run...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Take the others and get out...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Out to the barrenlands... where the corporations can't find you.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The barrenlands...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Yes... we're Pioneers...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Ha... haha! They're afraid of the wastes... we're not!
Run?
Turn, and run from your friends, run from your answers.
Run away and live. Isn't that what I've always wanted?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: What's that, Sonny... a letter? Someone back in town waiting for you to write? Man, you lucky bastard.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Maybe it'll become evidence.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Evidence?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: To let the people out there know what happened to us.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I thought we were just gonna save Dirk and the others.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What if we fail?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I wanna leave behind something, Sam. If we don't make it, I want people to know that we tried.
He wants to live.
But more than that, he wants someone to hear his voice.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Why do we have to wait for you to give us a chance?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's not fair.
He finds one of the bolts on the ground.
It's missing the head, but he still has his hands.
He's lost much to Oripathy. But he also gained a little bit—a sliver of power.
In the grand scheme of things, that power can't make a difference. Here and now, though, it is enough to snap the bolt in half.
The sharp cross-section could be a weapon against the enemy before him, to break the shackles imposed upon him.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't come any closer.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Grr...
He loses control of the bolt he's holding, then his hands themselves.
A powerful but invisible force grabs his wrists, forcing him to stop.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: My research was never intended to be used against you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It was designed to help you deal with the beasts of the wastes, overcome harsh terrain, and survive Catastrophes. To give you a chance.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It's supposed to protect you!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hah... protect us?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Did you ever ask what we wanted?
He will move forward. The more it is denied him, the more he will struggle.
The broken bolt tears through his skin, causing blood to drip from it.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Won't you just let this go?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Ha... haha!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, I don't wanna.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What's the situation at the site?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Defense says no one has left it.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: If all goes according to plan, Dorothy's 'Hub' should be complete by now.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Any news from Elena?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Negative.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: As of the last communication, she had not arrived at the observation station. Defense staff have not seen her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Go and prepare the latest batch of Transmitter.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: How much do you need?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: One-third.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: Time is running out for Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The experiments are going well, Colonel. We're in the final phase.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: We can't wait much longer.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: The aftershocks of the Victorian Incident continue to reverberate. Both our friends and our enemies are making preparations.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: We believe a weapon like that remains in the hands of someone, somewhere.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: A century of hard work could vanish in the blink of an eye if they target one of our cities.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: We'll be dragged back under the dark clouds, at the mercy of other nations.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: That's why we need more advanced technology... the technology to deliver our weapons to any location with precision, regardless of distance.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: Yes. Columbia needs a 'guide'.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: You're smart, Clooney, and you're more practical than most smart people.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: When this deal is done, I look forward to a fruitful partnership with the new Control of Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The feeling is mutual.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Send more hands to the labs to package the reagents.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Yes, I need all of it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whew... these guys are a headache.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You've seen my Arts. They're nowhere near as practical as Greyy's.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes, we've proven that their liquid structure is extremely resilient.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: And there is worse news.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did I mention that there's more of this material stored above us, all over the lab complex? Like, ten thousand times more, give or take.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Maybe you should have mentioned that sooner.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You said they were byproducts of the experiments. What was the main objective?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: A new technology that would replace traditional Arts Units.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Energy was responsible for developing this special material. It's extremely sensitive to microvibrations, making it the ideal medium for receiving and encoding neural signals.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We call it 'Transmitter'.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Under ideal circumstances, it can turn someone with ordinary Originium Arts assimilation into an outstanding caster.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's why... even the byproduct... can be very... dangerous!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, I can't fight and give a lecture at the same time.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sometimes I wish I had one of those devices like in Joyce's brain. That way, I could tell you stuff with just a thought.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Well then, let me ask another question.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How do we stop this experiment?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know you put a lot into it, and I understand your loyalty to Dorothy. But...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Enough, Olivia, you're reminding me of my sister again.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The project is important to me, but something's clearly not right with Dorothy... did you think I was the kind of person who can't get my priorities straight?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... just... need... to... think.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I haven't spent enough time here. I wish I pestered Dorothy more...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...The caster.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Elena, if the things before us are products of Originium Arts, where is the caster?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's not Dorothy controlling them. They're just there by her side.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The missing Pioneers...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The one place in the lab that Dorothy is most hesitant to show us.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Use your Originium Arts, Elena! Aim behind her!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Max power, right?
Starlight rains from the sky, catching everybody's attention for an instant.
Even the strange silver entities.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No, not there!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You shouldn't have done that, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I can't stop... what's going on?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's like my limbs aren't my own... how much is that equipment worth? Never mind... got to hold on...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's not just us. Even the Pioneers...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: An earthquake?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hang in there!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Star... stars...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce... Olivia... I can't keep my hold on her...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm losing sensation in my hands!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: A-Arts...!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Never thought the day would come when I would be giving myself electric shocks...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Electric?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Electricity can interfere with Originium Arts effects...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did you say that this research is focused on vibration?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yeah... and?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sand.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sand's everywhere in the lab. On us, too... so small we never even noticed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Keep looking for the test subjects, Elena!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'll stop Dorothy.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sir, the reagents have been loaded.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Good. We're going to Site 359.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: You're going there personally?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Did I not make myself clear?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Er, I just thought there were enough staff there already...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Tell me, why is it that the more important an experiment is, the more times it has to be repeated?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Er... to avoid errors?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Because an important result must be absolutely reliable.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Is Director Franks not reliable?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Dorothy? She is driven by her emotions, and achieved great things because of them.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: But her emotions may also become a weakness, at key moments.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: What about Elena?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I hope you grow faster than her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: She is motivated, but too inexperienced. She may not be able to make the best possible decision without my advice.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: There's only one person at Rhine Lab whom I trust implicitly—me.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Dr. Silence...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: *Cough*... hello, Director Franks.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How did you come this far? I thought the vibration membrane would cut off nerve signals to your limbs.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm a physician. I know the human body a little better than you do.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm sorry. I know it must be uncomfortable.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The experiment will be complete in just a little bit. I'll set you free when we're done.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And then...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Is it really worth the damage that's being done?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Look at the people who are struggling right now.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't... give... up!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Grab... my... hand!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Those focused on the future tend to ignore what's happening in front of them.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've seen many people like that at Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But Director Franks... Dorothy... you're not like them.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There are tears in your eyes when you look at Sonny and the other Pioneers.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can feel their pain.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But which is worse? A moment of pain, or an eternity of pain?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The life they lead is a quagmire, Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I want to pull them up, give them the same chances that you and I once had.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: A drowning man may struggle even more when he feels someone pulling him.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But is that really him refusing help?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The bog has choked them, but I hear their cries for help. I've extended my hand, and I'm not about to pull it back now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But you need to stop.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Your drone... when did you...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: While you were talking.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've seen many places since I left Rhine Lab, some of them even worse than this sand-filled lab of yours.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A physician knows how to keep her equipment clean at all times.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy... she won't even think about giving up...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (My hands are getting number.)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (Another shock? I'll probably fry my nerves.)

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Light.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Light? My Arts? You didn't use to love my Arts show this much, Joyce.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Stars... bright...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Far away.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Where are you looking... what are you looking at?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, what really matters isn't what you're looking at...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's what you know... what did you learn that Olivia and I didn't?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Home...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: In the light.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You... you're moving?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wait, you were unconscious... that's why the vibration membrane didn't affect you as much.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The direction you're pointing...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's the direction the silver constructs are gathering in.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I know where the missing people went.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Look, a door opened—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Door... opened?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No, look out—
All the vibrations stop.
The silver constructs dissolve into harmless pools of liquid.
Dorothy too stops dead in her tracks, giving up resistance even with Silence's drone at her neck.
All she sees is the door, and everything behind it.
What she vowed to protect, and the countless dreams that she carries.
